descriptionHtml:
Want to look like a model? If yes, then buy this elegant pretty dress with sleeves. It features an A-line silhouette, round neck and half sleeves. The silver hot drill decoration on the wedding guest dress makes it look elegant and classy. This gorgeous burgundy and navy blue evening dress with sleeves can easily be paired with silver accessories and you will definitely make all head turns. We think this gorgeous long mermaid evening dress is perfect for all formal occasions, from evening party, cocktail, weddings to prom, homecoming, and graduation!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, without lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
